description: Put an app's source on this computer from the platform, so work can continue here without git: downloads the live version (or a chosen one), unpacks it into a directory and writes deploy.json. Needs a signed-in account. After cloning, edits are published with deploy from that directory.

project.description: Project id or the app's name (slug).

version.description: A specific version number from versions. Defaults to the live version.

name: clone
title: Clone an app here
